cacheSemantics: 103e1850 initializes candidate and committed geometry to zero, age=-1, min=5, max=40, valid=false. 103dde40 at103de050..103de072 adds its float simulation delta only when candidate age>-0.5. Committed age is not incremented.
103e3160 first resolves the current target handle. A missing/stale/null target clears only candidate.valid and copies the candidate result without resetting age or geometry.

A query refreshes when age<0, age>requested maximum age, a non--1 minimum differs, or squared3D distance from cached targetGround to the current target exceeds requestedMovement squared. Comparisons at equal tolerances reuse. targetAtPlan is NOT this movement-test origin.

Maximum and farthest are not reuse keys. When a refresh actually occurs, negative minimum/maximum reuse their previous stored values; the new nonnegative values are stored, targetAtPlan captures the current target,103e1cc0 runs, valid stores its result, and age resets to0 even on failure.

Failed search can write targetGround before reporting failure. The Java search result preserves this output independently from valid path geometry; an initial failed relocation can retain the previous ground output. Native failed start/end writes are not exposed as usable flight geometry by the adapter.

103e3350 message0x32 subtype0 invokes the candidate query. Subtype1 copies committed+0x590 into the message. Subtype2 copies the entire0x44-byte candidate record from+0x54c to+0x590 via1020bef0; it does not recompute, select or validate. Subsequent candidate changes and age do not mutate the committed copy.

PrepareTightStrafeRun start10214080 queries candidate with both tolerances Float.MAX_VALUE, then commits through subtype2 only after preparing and validating its route. TightStrafeRun start10213620 retrieves subtype1. A cache query can be evaluated repeatedly during weighted bank selection without becoming a commitment.
volumeSemantics: RTTI ReserveVolumeAction start10204220 and update10202c90 branch on track+0x1c(StrafeRun). True resolves its actor and queries subtype0 candidate using Float.MAX_VALUE for both tolerances and -1/-1 scan limits (101fec10 defaults). This is not a committed-route query.

10202aa0 constructs an OBB from raw candidate endpoints: center=(start+end)/2 including Y; along=normalize((end-start).xz); side=(-along.z,0,along.x); up=(0,1,0); half extents=(horizontalLength/2,Radius,Radius). It is not a capsule, sloped box, aircraft footprint or complete raised flight route.

Strafe update101fed60 compares only the new candidate start to action+0x2c, component by component with inclusive tolerance1. Endpoint-only changes or radius changes do not rebuild it. If a start component changes by>1,10202c90 removes the owner record and inserts the new OBB;10202aa0 stores the new start.

StrafeRun=false uses101fff90: query navigation message0x26 subtype1; when both response flags are true, take its position, otherwise take the actor position. It inserts a sphere with track Radius. Update10070b60 uses the same componentwise inclusive1 tolerance before owner removal and replacement.

Manager+0xba8 contains up to50 owned records of0x44 bytes; end pointer+0x18f0. Shape type+0x3c distinguishes sphere0 and OBB1; owner handle is+0x40. Insertion10385060/10385100 has no overlap denial and silently skips at capacity. Finish101fedb0 calls103853d0 with action owner handle. Removal finds that exact handle and swap-removes the record, with shape lifecycle callbacks. This does not release the separate attack token.

Conflict query10382830(point,queryRadius,exceptOwner) checks103824e0 then ignores matches belonging to exceptOwner. Sphere contact is inclusive distance <= (reservedRadius+queryRadius)^2. For abs(queryRadius)<=float1e-5, it instead uses point containment. OBB point boundaries are inclusive (107c1050); nonzero query spheres use the strict nearest-OBB distance squared < radius squared (107c6e30), so exact external tangency is free.

Anonymous spheres at+0x50c/+0x830, insertion10384410 and positional removal10383370, are a different subsystem. 10382680 checks those points with strict distance<radiusSquared. They must not be substituted for the owned ReserveVolume table or its owner-based cleanup.
minecraftAdaptations: HelicopterAirspace is isolated per ServerLevel through a WeakHashMap whose value only weakly references the level. UUID plus same-world loaded entity presence substitutes for handle index/generation; removal/world departure discards stale caches and volumes without loading entities.

The coordinator advances once per observed gameTime, not per aircraft call. Standard ticks use float0.05 seconds. Lazy catch-up advances at most41 lease steps because all request durations are<=2 seconds, and adds elapsed seconds to candidate age. No token release is added to volume cleanup or cache invalidation.

One active volume per aircraft is the MC action model; native storage can append duplicate owner handles. Replacing one UUID cannot overwrite a different owner. Registration returns false for invalid geometry/capacity rather than silently claiming success. It retains native separation of insertion from pointAvailable conflict queries.

One MC block per source grid cell, local origin and MOTION_BLOCKING_NO_LEAVES heightmap are explicit adapters, not decoded original navigation units. groundAt uses getChunkNow plus loaded chunk height+1; unavailable or out-of-border cells returnNaN. No getChunk/getHeight call on Level can request a new chunk.

areaHeight uses upward-rounded odd width (30=>31,60=>61 cells), with work bound257. Any missing sample fails closed. The path search likewise rejects missing terrain rather than native zero-height fallback. Source-bound candidate geometry can remain cached until its documented age/movement invalidation.

Finite inputs and positive horizontal OBB length are required; a failed candidate cannot reserve a zero/uninitialized corridor. Callers own lifecycle: reserveSource while track active, releaseVolume on end, and clearCache/forget on MC capture/interruption/world departure as required by live combat.
